results.q: I want to change something on my Circles profile, what should I do?
results.a: Go to the Passport section from the main menu and then you can change your profile name and photo.

results.q: I can't change my Circles profile, what should I do?
results.a: You should be able to change your profile name and photo, if you cannot do this, please contact support from the menu on the left side of the screen.
